name: underpowered-point-over-margin-bound-not-firing
why: THE CONJUNCTION. Leg B fails iff BOTH the one-sided 95 % lower bound exceeds 1.0 AND the point exceeds the 1.20 margin. Here the point is 1.30 — over the margin — but the per-pair ratios are spread widely enough that the cluster bootstrap's lower bound sits at 0.5, so the bound leg does not fire. A-1.12's first UNDERPOWERED branch reads exactly this shape, and the UNDERPOWERED branch exists so a point-only exceedance is not adjudicated as a clean miss. An implementation that failed leg B on the point alone would call this a MISS.
